subject: runMI: NAs in Objective Function Optimization?

messages.subject: runMI: NAs in Objective Function Optimization?
parts:
Greetings,

currently I am running a structural model (350+ parameters) through 80 multiply imputed datasets with the runMI function. As the computation time is significantly large (24+ hrs, even with change of BLAS), I turn the verbose = TRUE to track progress. I note that very early on the iterations of optimization of the objective function start to return NA every two or three lines. What would be the cause for such a value? 

e.g.:
Objective function = 16927690965.1624412536521094
Objective function = NA
Objective function = NA
Objective function = 16927307063.1865417319156598
...
